Memory._note: Empty = %LOCALAPPDATA%/SoulCore/memory/soulcore_memory.db. Never point at LLMOD Data/.

Inference._note: Set Enabled=false to register NullInferenceClient when Ollama unavailable.

Hermes._note: Chat requires SOULCORE_HERMES_API_KEY (env/user-secrets). Do not put ApiKey values in this file.

ChatWs._note: Presence clients: ws://127.0.0.1:7700/ws. StubWhenModelDown=false → error frame chat.model_down when LLM unreachable (no silent stub success).

UnrealBridge._note: Canonical UE project for :8888 still open freeze — default documented. Host must not crash if UE down.

SoulLoop._note: KILL SWITCH: Enabled=false by default. Scaffold only (want log / loop.want). No browser/MT4/email/file acts. Set true only for local evidence.

_secrets_note: Do not put API tokens here. Use env SOULCORE_* or `dotnet user-secrets`. Key names: SOULCORE_A2E_TOKEN, SOULCORE_HERMES_API_KEY, SOULCORE_HF_TOKEN.
